messageTr: Belge bir DOCTYPE/DTD bildirimi içeriyor: For security reasons DTD is prohibited in this XML document. To enable DTD processing set the DtdProcessing property on XmlReaderSettings to Parse and pass the settings into XmlReader.Create method.
messageEn: The document contains a DOCTYPE/DTD declaration: For security reasons DTD is prohibited in this XML document. To enable DTD processing set the DtdProcessing property on XmlReaderSettings to Parse and pass the settings into XmlReader.Create method.
fixTr: <!DOCTYPE ...> bildirimini ve tanımlı varlıkları kaldırın; özel karakterleri doğrudan UTF-8 olarak yazın.
fixEn: Remove the <!DOCTYPE ...> declaration and any entity definitions; write special characters directly as UTF-8.
